highball.definition: n. a mixed drink made of alcoholic liquor mixed with water or a carbonated beverage and served in a tall glass
highball.translation: n. 掺了姜汁啤酒的威士忌, 掺了苏打水的威士忌

highball glass.translation: [网络] 高球杯；海波杯；杯中

highballs.definition:
plural of highball
n. a mixed drink made of alcoholic liquor mixed with water or a carbonated beverage and served in a tall glass
highballs.translation: (highball 的复数) n. 掺了姜汁啤酒的威士忌, 掺了苏打水的威士忌

highbinder.translation: n. (被雇暗杀人的)恶棍, 美国华人区黑社会中的党羽

highboy.definition: n. a tall chest of drawers divided into two sections and supported on four legs

highbred.translation: a. 纯种的, 出身高贵, 有教养的

highbrow.definition:
n. a person of intellectual or erudite tastes
s. highly cultured or educated
highbrow.translation:
n. (自以为)文化修养高的人, 卖弄知识的人
a. 自炫博学的, 知识分子的, 不切实际的

highbrowed.translation:
a. 不切实际的；自炫博学的；知识分子的
n. 卖弄知识的人；知识分子

highbrowism.translation: 自以为有学问, 炫耀学问

highbrows.definition: n. a person of intellectual or erudite tastes
highbrows.translation: n. 文化修养高的人( highbrow的复数形式 )

highbush.translation: a. 形成高(挺)灌木的, (果实)产在高(挺)灌木上的

highbush cranberry.translation: 【植物】三裂叶夹蒾(Viburnum trilobum)[亦称作 cranberry bush, cranberry tree]
